title.en: A concrete example and a counterexample

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的宁在GMS依次选1、4、2、3、2，乔选4、1、2、2、3，两个总分都为12，但重要感、关注、兴趣与依赖的回答组合不同。数字既没有询问具体他人的想法，也没有证明两人收到相同对待。若宁同时在AMS合计16，两个数也不相减为“净价值”：想到不同人、不同关系或不同经历都可能影响回答，网页没有核实是哪一种。可先回看各题所描述的感受，不必为了让两份表看起来一致而改答案。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Ning selects 1, 4, 2, 3, 2 on GMS; Jo selects 4, 1, 2, 2, 3. Both totals are 12, with different combinations of importance, attention, interest and dependence. Neither record asks other people what they think or establishes equal treatment. If Ning also totals 16 on AMS, subtracting the two creates no net worth. Different people, relationships or experiences may shape responses; the page verifies no explanation. Revisit the feelings each item describes without changing answers to make the scales appear consistent.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样保留相同总分下不同的题间组合，同时不把“别人依赖我”当作必须承担更多任务的要求？”可以只针对上述虚构人物，指出已知、推断和未知的部分。参与者可以不同意、不回答或结束，不必公开个人分数、私人关系、诊断或他人身份，也不要求当事人回应、坦白或证明谁更值得关心。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can different item patterns beneath equal totals remain visible without turning others’ dependence into a requirement to take on more tasks?” Use only the fictional readers above to distinguish known information, inference and unknowns. Participants may disagree, decline or end without disclosing personal scores, private relationships, diagnoses or anyone’s identity. No response, disclosure or proof of who deserves more care is required.

paragraphs.zh: 本版本并列呈现GMS五题与AMS五题，针对与一般人相处的体验，不另加过去一周、一个月或某段关系的固定回忆窗。英文题文按Flett等（2022）表2选择，四锚点及分别加总参考Krygsman等（2022）；不是GMS-6或十题单量表。选项直接计1完全没有、2有一点、3有些、4很多，没有0、反向题、跳过得分或中立选项。每份表五题完整才给各自5—20合计；缺项不填0、不用其他题或另一份表推测，不折算、不按剩余均值放大。本页作答流程需十题全部明确选择才进入私人结果，可以退出并无分阅读，两份完整公开指南作答前也可读。各题回答可修改；修改会先清除当前结果，重测则清空本次回答。总分是有序选项的算术和，不是被喜欢百分比、价值、重要性客观排名或他人已核实评价。GMS与AMS相关但不同，保留各自方向，不合并、相减、反向或选主导类型；相同数字不表示平衡，两项较大也不由网页判成矛盾。研究中的结构、相关和纵向关联不能生成本站个人诊断、风险概率、关系安全判决或因果解释。所选发表题文有研究依据，但本站网页呈现、新中文工作译文及语言等值未经独立验证，无临床切点、个人常模或有意义变化阈值；其他中文版本的结果不自动验证本版。来源、署名、许可及改动说明保留；新情境和讨论由费马编辑补充，不代表原作者背书。不需要通过更有用、向谁证明价值、披露或联系某人来使数字改变；可按实际需要寻求适当支持，不必越过分数门槛。答案和合计只留当前页内存，无草稿或账户历史，刷新、换语言、离开、缓存恢复、清除或重测按现有流程移除。复制仅含两篇公开指南标题和链接，不含答案、合计或作答标识；常规页面分析关闭，可选匿名动作计数需本页许可与全站分析同意。清除不抹掉浏览器历史、截屏或旁人看屏；可以只读、拒绝讨论或停止。
paragraphs.en: This edition presents five GMS and five AMS items separately about experiences with people in general, without adding a fixed week, month or single-relationship recall window. English items follow Flett et al. (2022), Table 2; four anchors and separate sums follow Krygsman et al. (2022). This is neither GMS-6 nor one ten-item scale. Direct choices are one not at all, two a little, three somewhat and four a lot: no zero, reversed item, scored skip or neutral option. Each scale needs its own five responses for a 5–20 sum. Missing values become neither zero nor estimates from other items or the other scale, with no prorating or expansion from remaining means. This page enters the private result only after all ten explicit choices. Leaving and reading without scores is allowed; both full public guides are also readable before answering. Answers can be edited after clearing the current result; retaking clears the answers. A sum of ordered categories is no percentage liked, personal worth, objective importance ranking or verified opinion of others. GMS and AMS are related but distinct, retaining their directions without combining, subtracting, reversing or selecting a dominant type. Equal values establish no balance, and two larger totals are not declared contradictory. Research structure, correlations and longitudinal associations yield no personal diagnosis, risk probability, relationship-safety verdict or causal explanation here. Published items have research evidence, but this web presentation, Chinese working translation and language equivalence lack independent validation. There are no clinical cutoffs, personal norms or meaningful-change thresholds; other Chinese editions do not validate this one. Sources, credit, license and identified changes remain visible. FermatMind Editorial supplies these new scenes and discussion prompts without author endorsement. No greater usefulness, proof of worth, disclosure or contact is required to change a number. Appropriate support can address actual needs without a threshold. Responses and sums stay in current page memory without drafts or account history, following existing clearing on refresh, language change, leaving, cached-page restoration, clearing or retaking. Copying includes both public guide titles and links without answers, totals or an attempt identifier. Ordinary page analytics is disabled; optional anonymous action counts require page permission and site analytics consent. Clearing erases no browser history, screenshots or screen observation. Reading alone, declining discussion or stopping is allowed.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的沐在AMS依次选4、2、3、1、2，思选1、4、2、3、2，两个总分同为12，但对不被重视、被当作无足轻重、仿佛不存在及某些人未来不会重视的自述不同。题目里的“永远”记录当下所感到的说法，不确认未来，更不证明人物无足轻重。即使GMS也为12，两数相等不代表平衡、矛盾或抵消；某次回复延迟、反复被打断与人物的理解，应分别看待，不能单凭总分确定原因或否定持续的实际困扰。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Fictional Mu selects 4, 2, 3, 1, 2 on AMS; Si selects 1, 4, 2, 3, 2. Both totals are 12, with different reports of not mattering, being treated as insignificant or invisible, and expecting never to matter to certain people. Never in a prompt records a felt statement, not a verified future or proof of insignificance. Even if GMS is also 12, equality establishes no balance, contradiction or cancellation. A delayed reply, repeated interruptions and the reader’s interpretation need separate consideration. A total identifies no cause and cannot dismiss continuing actual distress.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样把人物报告的感受、已经发生的互动与尚未知的他人意图区分开，同时认真对待困扰？”可以只针对上述虚构人物，指出已知、推断和未知的部分。参与者可以不同意、不回答或结束，不必公开个人分数、私人关系、诊断或他人身份，也不要求当事人回应、坦白或证明谁更值得关心。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can reported feelings, observed interactions and unknown intentions remain distinct while distress is taken seriously?” Use only the fictional readers above to distinguish known information, inference and unknowns. Participants may disagree, decline or end without disclosing personal scores, private relationships, diagnoses or anyone’s identity. No response, disclosure or proof of who deserves more care is required.
